description: This file is a C source file implementing cache management routines for a Linux-based embedded system, specifically a function to flush the CPU cache for a given memory region on Atheros AR7XXX/AR9XXX boards. It includes references to hardware-specific cache operations and external headers related to cache control.

methods.name: void flush_cache(unsigned long start_addr,unsigned long size)
methods.description: Flushes (writes back and invalidates) the CPU cache for a specified memory region given by start address and size.

ctags.name: flush_cache
ctags.pattern: /^void flush_cache(unsigned long start_addr, unsigned long size)$/
